verdict.rationale: llamafile is built for self-hosting. It bundles the model weights, inference engine and runtime into one executable that runs entirely on your own device, offline. It also includes a local HTTP server, API and Web UI, with server sandboxing that blocks outbound network connections. Hands-on users confirm it ran first try on Linux with no network connection and that they use it daily. Missing for 10: smooth cross-platform deployment, since users report the 4GB executable limit on Windows, GPU acceleration setup friction, and a failure on NixOS.
